title: A tiny kernel model
description:
Put processes, handle tables and system calls together in one small model of a kernel.

```
create process "game" (pid 4)
game: open("save.dat", read) -> handle 4
game: write(handle 4) -> access denied
game: exit -> handles closed, object freed
kernel log: 4 calls, 1 refused
```
hints: Reuse the handle table and system call table from the earlier projects of this milestone (lesson 15.03).
Every call starts by finding the process; a pid that does not exist is refused.
requirements: Each process has a pid and its own handle table.
System calls go through one entry point that checks the number, the process and the arguments.
Process exit closes every handle the process still has.
stretch: Add a second process and show that handles are per process.
